title: `NavigationAgent3D`: High velocity causes tunneling effect on waypoints, breaking path traversal logic
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.6.dev3.mono

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev3.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9144) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 63.65 GiB memory

### Issue description

When a `NavigationAgent3D` moves with high velocity relative to its `path_desired_distance`, it experiences a "tunneling" effect where it completely traverses the acceptance radius of a waypoint within a single physics frame.

Currently, the `NavigationAgent3D` appears to perform a discrete distance check (`distance_to_target <= path_desired_distance`) at the end of the frame. If the displacement vector \vec{v} \cdot \Delta t is large enough, the agent moves from "in front" of the waypoint to "behind" the waypoint without ever landing *inside* the tolerance radius during a tick.

**Mathematical Context:**
Given:

* P_t: Current position
* P_{t+1}: Position next frame (P_t + \vec{v} \cdot \Delta t)
* W: Waypoint position
* r: `path_desired_distance`

If \|P_t - W\| > r and \|P_{t+1} - W\| > r, the agent fails to update its internal path index, even if the line segment \overline{P_t P_{t+1}} intersects the sphere defined by (W, r).

**Consequences:**

1. `get_next_path_position()` continues to return the *passed* waypoint.
2. If using standard steering behaviors, the agent immediately attempts to turn 180 degrees to go back to the missed point.
3. Increasing `path_desired_distance` mitigates this but reduces path following precision, which is not a viable tradeoff for high-speed precision gameplay (e.g., racing or fast-paced action).

The standard library should ideally perform a segment-sphere intersection test or a projection scalar check to see if the agent "passed" the point during the frame, rather than a static distance check.


### Steps to reproduce

1. download MRP
2. run
3. you should see agent back and forth around corner rather than move to next point.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[agent-high-speed.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24147811/agent-high-speed.zip)
